svg.text: A bright, eerie otherworld: bold ink outlines, saturated jewel colors, flat painted shadows, gold and aquamarine glows.
Same shapes; jewel colors, gold light, flat shadows.
The rift shows as aquamarine: eye, arrow, runes, sigil.
On a golden meadow: the teal cloak and ink outlines pop.
About 100 px tall: warm ground, cool units; both forms read.
